From: DURUCHART <chartering@duruchart.com>

Subject: Back to Blacksea 

 

DURUCHART/Istanbul                                       

+90 216 492 97 13

 

Good day 

 


Pls offer firm for;

 

Savona /  Samsun 

10.000 mt (+/-10 pct) ,metcoke in bulk,3 grades 

1200 sx  / 3000 sc

11/14 May     

3.75 add pus

 

Grade 1 : 2.000 mt (+/-%10) 60-140mm stw abt 74/75 

Grade 2 : 6.000 mt ( +/-%10) 60-100mm stw abt 69/70  

Grade 3 : 2.000 mt (+/-%10) 90-250mm stw abt 76/77 

 

*holdwise grade separation needed

 

Best Regards

Mehmet Ali Lapaoglu

M:+905354084626

 

If you no longer wish to receive emails from us, reply to this message with
the subject  "DELETE"

 



-- 
This email has been checked for viruses by AVG antivirus software.
www.avg.com
